'''Diddop''' was a thug whom the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]] [[Watto/Legends|Watto]] hired to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] following the conclusion of the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve]] [[Podracing/Legends|Podrace]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. Along with four other hirelings, Diddop ambushed Jinn in a deserted [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] backstreet, but the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master roundly defeated his assailants.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Diddop and the group of hired thugs appear in ''[[Episode I: Qui-Gon Jinn]]'', a one-shot [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] story written by [[Ryder Windham]] that ties into the [[1999]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]. According to [[Star Wars Galaxy Collector 6|''Star Wars Galaxy Collector'' 6]], Diddop's name is provided in the comic's script. He and two other thugs, [[Denno Thuk]] and [[Bongor]], are not identified in the comic book story.
